x: Mr. Ron Goodman, who hails from H.H.H., in proposing the toast "The Club" jocularly questioned the use of the definite pronoun, but admitted later that he had actually come round to admiring past runners like Bert Footer and Arthur Penny and,of the present team, was even beginning to like Charlie Walker!
Who better to propose the toast to the guests than our distinguished Club Secretary, and the response by Ron Goodman, President of the Surrey County A.A.A. was a good follow up.
Surrey County Past President Ron Goodman has gone one better with "Lord Harley" of Belgrave". There is no doubt that for statesmanship and diplomacy he is ideal ambassadorial material.
Of course that was said in the fun of an after-dinner speech but I meant the sentiment and still do...." Ron Goodman
